name: obs-mcp
description: Control OBS Studio via MCP — manage scenes, sources, recording, streaming and more
long_description:
Connects Claude to OBS Studio through the OBS WebSocket protocol (v5). Allows you to control scenes, sources, recording, streaming, filters, transitions, and other OBS features directly from Claude.

**Requirements:**
- OBS Studio 28+ with WebSocket Server enabled (`Tools → WebSocket Server Settings`)

obs_websocket_url.title: OBS WebSocket URL
obs_websocket_url.description: WebSocket URL for OBS Studio. Configure in OBS: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings

obs_websocket_password.title: OBS WebSocket Password
obs_websocket_password.description: Password from OBS WebSocket Server Settings. Leave empty if authentication is disabled.
